value.rationale: A precise stability gap and an exact characterization of the nearest nonalternating competitors are natural quantitative questions not answered by a qualitative unique maximizer. The central doubled-run rigidity and positive n-times-entropy-gap limit distinguish the result from merely repeating the first entropy level or a finite table. It is a nontrivial all-length structural extremum, with channel interpretation and explicit equality cases.
